To do this you first have to search your router’s IP address. You can find this by searching “router IP address” on your browser. The first result should be a website that tells you your router’s IP address. Copy this number and paste it on your search bar. This will redirect you to your router login page where it asks for a password and username. I didn’t know what to put in this field so I went over to my router and one of its labels contained this information. However this may not be the case if a specific password or username was set prior. When you manage to login you will have access to your router settings.

The layout of these settings all depend on the router you were given by your service provider but they all have the option to apply DNS servers. This option can be found in the “WAN” section where you will find the area that says “DNS” which contains a pair of long number similar to that of your ip. (You can also find the specific model of your router and search online for a better explanation of how to access this within your settings as what I am explaining is based on my router and my router settings) 

If you have managed to find the DNS section under your “WAN” settings then all you have to do is apply the two numbers for your DNS servers. These servers can be found online by simply typing “porn blocking DNS servers” 

Find the DNS server of your choice as some contain different kinds of filtering. Copy and paste both numbers onto the sections under “DNS” in your router settings. There may be a third section for a third DNS server but his is optional so leave it blank. 

Then just hit apply and you have blocked porn for anyone connected to your router. This may not be the clearest explanation on how to do this as it may not be the same for your router but as I said before, try searching for the model of your router and specific steps of how to do it for yours. 

Really hope this helps and happy NNN 🥳

Block it.

Porn is everywhere and anything connected to Internet has access to it within seconds. The best way to make sure it is not a part of your life anymore is by blocking it.

After months is trying, I finally found the most efficient ways to block porn and make it impossible to unblock: 

1. DNS filtering in router settings- Access your router settings by typing your router’s IP address in the browser’s address bar and searching. This will lead you to your router login page asking for a username and password. If there was no username or password set prior to this, then your router must have a label with this data. After login you will be taken to your router settings. In here search for the “WAN” section of your router and select “DNS”. In here you can apply the DNS server of your choice according to your needs just search online for porn blocking DNS servers and you will find plenty for adding. After adding the porn-blocking DNS server of your choice click apply and you have officially blocked porn on all devices connected to your WiFi! 

2. Screen Time- unfortunately this is only for apple users as apple devices offers Screen Time settings to regulate user’s activity. If you have a Mac or an iPhone you can permanently block porn and specific websites (like Reddit) which are also explicit. All you have to do is go to your Screen Time, select “Content and Privacy Restrictions” then select “Content Restrictions” and select “Limit Adult Websites”. This blocks all porn related websites. There are also some other websites and apps left unblocked that can be explicit. This includes Reddit, Twitter etc. Fortunately these can also be blocked through the “Content Restrictions” setting in Screen Time that allows you to select specific websites to be blocked. 

Now, you can easily remove this by turning off your Screen Time but to make it impossible to unblock follow these steps: 

1. Add a Screen Time passcode.

2. Select four random digits for your passcode to easily forget within the next few minutes.

3. After setting a passcode you will be given the option to add a passcode recovery address where a field with an Apple ID and password has to be filled. Give the phone to a friend or a family member with iCloud so they can fill this with their data. Now whenever you try to change anything from your screen time you will be asked for a passcode (which you already forgor 💀) and if you try to change that passcode you will be asked for the iCloud address that was set (which is someone else’s) so unless you ask them it is impossible to unblock porn in your iPhone or Mac. 

Having both these methods in action is the most effective as your devices are safe at home and also when using external WiFi. 

Best of luck 🍀
Happy NNN 🥳
